title: Innate Immunity in HIV Positive Patients Co-infected With Hepatitis C Virus (HCV) or Hepatitis B Virus (HBV)
brief_summary: Data from this study will provide the first information how the innate immune system may be altered in HIV-HCV and HIV-HBV co-infected individuals, and describe Toll-like receptor changes with HIV co-infection therapy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* HIV and either HBV or HCV co-infection
* 18 years and older
* able to give informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* HIV-HBV-HCV triple infection
